description:
Welcome to your perfect Nashville getaway a stylish, modern retreat designed for group trips, weekend getaways, business travel, and unforgettable Music City experiences.

Located just 2.5 miles (5-10 minutes) from Broadway, and Division/Demonbrun, Nissan Stadium, and some of the city’s best restaurants, bars, and entertainment, this spacious home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style.

The space
Inside, you’ll find:
• Spacious open-concept living areas
• Comfortable sleeping arrangements for large groups
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Fast WiFi and smart TVs
• Washer & dryer
• Free on-site parking
• Modern finishes and updated amenities throughout
